name: What are the first steps I should take when planning a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps I should take when planning a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Begin by defining your needs and desires for the new bathroom, including functionality and aesthetic preferences. Consider your budget range, as this will guide material choices and the scope of work. Gather inspiration from magazines or online platforms to help visualize your ideal space. Next, research and select a reputable general contractor in your service area. A contractor can provide expert advice on design, feasibility, and potential costs, helping to refine your vision into a practical plan before any work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by defining your needs, setting a budget, and gathering design inspiration. Then, find a reputable general contractor to help plan the project.
